summary: Emergent Google Auth (backend + frontend) fully validated. 9/9 pytest cases pass (session, /me bearer+cookie, expired, logout). Frontend: guest laptop screen shows Google button and clicking redirects to https://auth.emergentagent.com/oauth/?redirect=<origin> (then to Google). With seeded session_token cookie, navbar shows avatar and laptop shows 'Welcome, Test.' signed-in view with logout. Logout resets to login form and /api/auth/me → 401. Regression: hero, Mumbai/+91 93726 71748/LinkedIn/Twitter all present in contact section. No blocking console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: get_current_user correctly uses cookie-first, Bearer fallback and projects out _id. create_auth_session upserts by email and stores ISO datetime — clean.
AuthContext.js correctly skips /me while hash contains session_id (prevents 401 flash during OAuth callback).

Non-blocking: 12 console messages during regression include 401 for /api/auth/me (expected as guest before auth resolves) and ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED on the placeholder avatar (via.placeholder.com — flaky external host). Consider swapping the seeded placeholder picture to a data URL or same-origin asset to silence errors.
test_credentials: MongoDB seeded: user_id=test-user-auth1, email=test.user.auth1@example.com, session_token=test_session_auth1 (fresh 7-day expiry). Expired token: test_session_expired.
seed_data_creation: Reseeded test_session_auth1 (7d) and test_session_expired via mongosh + inside pytest setup_module. Logout test uses ephemeral tokens.
